profile.headline: Software Developer at Board of Regents of the University System of Georgia

company.name: Board of Regents of the University System of Georgia

positions.title: Software Developer - Security and Workflow
positions.description: Provide end-user as well as internal support for security and workflow within both PeopleSoft Financials and PeopleSoft Human Capital Management. Write functional specifications detailing system customizations and perform system testing for application upgrades as well as bundles and fixes. Troubleshoot Security access issues and provide guidance to institutional security administrators or Shared Services Center. Design, update and identify issues with electronic workflow. Maintain permission lists and user preferences. Design and perform integration testing for PeopleSoft HCM and identify/address issues with interfaced data and/or Integration Broker. Perform monthly audits and assist with annual audits, adhering to audit and compliance policies. Create end user documentation and training materials, deliver training and presentations virtually and in person. Implement automated deprovisioning process in PeopleSoft Financials to remove access from terminated employees. Maintain passwords for all application and database accounts in both PeopleSoft Financials and PeopleSoft Human Capital Management.

positions.title: Business Systems Analyst II
positions.description: Provide end-user and project support for PeopleSoft Financials. Research and resolve issues reported by travel and expense users located at institutions throughout the state of Georgia. Develop SQL scripts to resolve issues using database interventions.  Lead focus groups and fit/gap sessions to formulate application changes needed to meet business requirements. Write functional specifications detailing system customizations and perform system testing for application upgrades, as well as bundles and fixes.  Deliver training and presentations at ITS and the InteractUSG conference.

positions.title: Accounting Technician
positions.description: Established accounting practices for the newly opened Diversion Center.  Managed daily account activity: Maintained resident accounts using Lockdown inmate fund management system, performed allowance distributions, facilitated child support payments, handled banking transactions, as well as governmental accounting entries into Eden software.

positions.title: Customer Service Specialist
positions.description: Assisted students with selection and purchase of textbooks and supplies, processed financial aid vouchers using Oracle and PeopleSoft, trained and supported new employees, balanced daily receipts and generated reports.

positions.title: Accounting Technician
positions.description: Processed revenues from all city departments, completed departmental check requests using Advantage software, collected license fees and liquor taxes, balanced daily receipts, generated payroll tax and wire transfer payments, produced reports, balanced city bank accounts, inventoried and requisitioned supplies.

positions.title: Assistant to the Vice President
positions.description: Performed administrative duties for the Vice President, created purchase orders, requisitioned supplies for all departments, produced expense reports, coordinated large campus events, assisted students with registration, maintained personnel files, coordinated campus maintenance.

positions.title: Financial Services Specialist
positions.description: Processed new accounts and loan applications, provided account and service information, sent wire transfers, maintained safe deposit box records, collaborated with Proof department to reconcile general ledger accounts, met company sales goals, requisitioned supplies, trained and supported new associates.

positions.title: Teller
positions.description: Completed financial transactions with speed and accuracy, served as back-up vault teller, responsible for internal audits, trained and supported new tellers.
